faq.q: What is the Marbella Feria San Bernabe?
faq.a: The Feria San Bernabe is Marbella's annual summer fair, typically held in mid-June. It features a fairground with rides, live music, traditional flamenco, and casetas (tented bars) serving food and drink. The main celebrations take place in the fairground near the town centre, about 5 minutes from Puerto Banús.

faq.q: When exactly is the Feria San Bernabe 2041?
faq.a: Exact dates for 2041 are not yet confirmed, but the fair traditionally runs for about a week starting in the second or third week of June. We recommend checking the official Marbella council calendar closer to the date. For planning, assume mid-June 2041.

data.body_html:
The Marbella Feria San Bernabe 2041 is set to be one of the Costa del Sol's biggest summer parties. And what better way to celebrate than with a private boat party from Puerto Banús? Whether you're looking for a daytime cruise, a sunset session, or a full-day escape, chartering a yacht from our fleet puts you right at the heart of the action – with the freedom to enjoy the sea and then head to the fairground in the evening. In this guide, we'll cover everything you need to know: the best yachts, pricing, inclusions, and tips for making your Feria boat party unforgettable.

Why a Boat Party for Feria San Bernabe?

The Feria San Bernabe is Marbella's largest annual celebration, drawing thousands to its fairground, casetas, and live music stages. But the party doesn't stop on land. A boat party lets you enjoy the Mediterranean sunshine, swim in secluded coves like Cala del Faro or Cala Cortés, and return to Puerto Banús ready for the evening festivities. With our fleet departing from Puerto Banús – just 5 minutes from the fairground – you can seamlessly transition from sea to shore.

Our Fleet for the Ultimate Feria Party

We offer a range of yachts to suit different group sizes and budgets. All depart from Puerto Banús and include a licensed skipper, fuel, drinks, snacks, and insurance. Here are the top picks for a Feria boat party:

  • Astondoa 40 (12.5m, 9 pax) – Tier A: €749/2h or €2,299/8h. Ideal for small groups wanting a stylish, affordable option.
  • Azimut 39 (12.5m, 11 pax) – Tier A: same pricing. Slightly more space, perfect for up to 11 guests.
  • Mangusta 80 (24m, 12 pax) – Tier B: €4,719 minimum 4h, includes a free jet ski. The ultimate party yacht with plenty of deck space.
  • Azimut 58 Flybridge (17.6m, 12 pax) – pricing on request. A flybridge adds a great social area.
  • Ferretti 94 (29m, 12 pax) – pricing on request. Luxury at its finest.

For full details on all 17 yachts, see our complete fleet page.

Pricing and Inclusions

Our Tier A boats (Astondoa 40, Azimut 39) are available at fixed rates: €749 for 2 hours or €2,299 for 8 hours. This includes skipper, fuel, water, soft drinks, beer, white wine, cava, light snacks, insurance, and 21% IVA. No hidden fees. Tier B boats (Mangusta 80) start at €4,719 for 4 hours and include a free jet ski. For all other yachts, pricing is on request – simply contact us via WhatsApp for a quote.

Sample Itinerary for Feria Day

Here's a suggested plan to make the most of your Feria boat party:

  • 12:00 – Board your yacht at Puerto Banús. Meet your skipper, enjoy welcome drinks.
  • 12:30 – Set sail towards Cabopino or Estepona. Swim stops at Cala del Faro or Cala Cortés.
  • 14:00 – Lunch on board (you can bring your own food or order catering).
  • 16:00 – Return to Puerto Banús. Disembark and freshen up.
  • 18:00 – Head to the Feria fairground for evening casetas and music.

This itinerary is flexible – you can choose a 2-hour, 4-hour, or full-day charter.

Tips for Booking Your Feria Boat Party

  • Book early – Feria weeks are the busiest of the year. Secure your yacht at least 2–3 months in advance.
  • Choose the right yacht – For groups of 8–12, the Mangusta 80 or Azimut 58 are excellent. For smaller groups, the Astondoa 40 or Azimut 39 offer great value.
  • Combine with fair – A half-day charter (4h) lets you enjoy the sea and still have time for the fair in the evening.
  • Consider a sunset cruise – The sunset over La Concha mountain is spectacular from the water.
